claim_verdicts.evidence: Docs: "The `[Fact]` attribute declares a test method that's run by the test runner." Run on a git-archive copy of stage-0 with a probe file: the new [Fact] in ShippingFeeTests ran with no other change (Total: 3); a [Fact] in an `internal class` was not discovered (and raises analyzer error xUnit1000 "Test classes must be public").
claim_verdicts.source: refs/dotnet-docs/docs/core/testing/unit-testing-csharp-with-xunit.md:148; dotnet test on scratch copy of stage-0 (xunit 2.9.2, VSTest adapter 2.8.2, .NET 10.0.12)

claim_verdicts.evidence: Probe build: `error xUnit1001: Fact methods cannot have parameters` and `error xUnit1028: Test methods must have a supported return type. Valid types are: void, Task.` With the analyzers suppressed, the runtime reports `[Fact] methods are not allowed to have parameters. Did you mean to use [Theory]?`; `public async Task` fact passed.
claim_verdicts.source: dotnet build / dotnet test on scratch copy of stage-0 (xunit 2.9.2 analyzers)

claim_verdicts.evidence: xUnit docs show the failure output "Assert.Equal() Failure: Values differ / Expected: 5 / Actual: 4". Local run with `Assert.Equal(50_000, fee.ForOrder(500_000))`: `Expected: 50000 / Actual:   60000`; swapped to `Assert.Equal(fee.ForOrder(500_000), 50_000)`: `Expected: 60000 / Actual:   50000`.
claim_verdicts.source: https://xunit.net/docs/getting-started/v2/getting-started; dotnet test on scratch copy of stage-0

claim_verdicts.evidence: SamplesTests.cs:33-36 `order.AddLine(productId: 1, quantity: 1, unitPriceVnd: 1_250_000);` `order.AddLine(productId: 2, quantity: 2, unitPriceVnd: 450_000);` `Assert.Equal(2_150_000, order.TotalVnd);` and :44 `Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(order.MarkPaid);`. Code block (lines 27-46) matches the tag verbatim.
`if (lines.Count == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("an order with no lines cannot be paid");` in `public void MarkPaid()`.

Probe `Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(a)` where `a` throws ArgumentNullException failed: "Assert.Throws() Failure: Exception type was not an exact match / Expected: typeof(System.ArgumentException) / Actual: typeof(System.ArgumentNullException)". AnEmptyOrderCannotBePaid passes at stage-0, so the delegate is invoked.
claim_verdicts.source: dotnet test on scratch copy of stage-0 (xunit 2.9.2)

claim_verdicts.evidence: `public sealed class ExpressShipping : ShippingFee { public override int ForOrder(int totalVnd) => 60_000; }` — the argument is ignored.

Added the test (as `ShippingFee fee = new ExpressShipping(); Assert.Equal(60_000, fee.ForOrder(500_000));`) and ran `dotnet test samples/DonHang.Samples.Tests --filter ShippingFeeTests`: `Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 3, Total: 3`. With 50_000: `Failed ...ShippingFeeTests.ExpressShippingAlwaysCostsSixtyThousand ... Expected: 50000 Actual: 60000`, `Failed: 1, Passed: 2`. Swapped: `Expected: 60000 Actual: 50000`.
claim_verdicts.source: dotnet test on scratch copy of stage-0 (SDK 10.0)

claim_verdicts.evidence: Docs: "The name of your test should consist of three parts: Name of the method being tested; Scenario under which the method is being tested; Expected behavior when the scenario is invoked" and "when tests fail, you can see exactly which scenarios don't meet your expectations." The lesson gives the reason (failure report) and does not forbid the method name.

issues.text: Summary line 1 implies only public [Fact] methods run. Run on stage-0 (xunit 2.9.2): a `private void` and an `internal void` [Fact] method inside a public class were both discovered and passed, with no analyzer diagnostic. Only the class must be public (xUnit1000); section 4 states this correctly.
issues.quote: xUnit runs every public `[Fact]` method it finds
issues.fix: Replace with: "xUnit runs every `[Fact]` method in the project's public classes; there is no list of tests to register them in."

issues.text: Key (a) is still the only defensible option, but its wording adds a condition that is not required: a non-public [Fact] method in a public class also runs (verified on stage-0).
issues.quote: The `[Fact]` attribute on a public method in a public class
issues.fix: Change option a (en) to "The `[Fact]` attribute on a method in a public class" and vi to "Attribute `[Fact]` trên một method trong một class public".
